# Palm Hills Dev

> Palm Hills Dev (palmhillsdev.com) is a marketing platform for Palm Hills Developments projects in Egypt, owned and run by Ibrahim El Garhy, Sales Deputy Manager at Palm Hills. It is not the official Palm Hills website. It lists available units, prices and payment plans; contracts are signed directly with Palm Hills Developments.

Prices are in Egyptian pounds (EGP), are indicative, and may be changed by the developer without notice.
Contact: phone / WhatsApp +201031170002, email ibrahimelgarhy1987@gmail.com. The site is available in Arabic (https://palmhillsdev.com/) and English (https://palmhillsdev.com/en/).

## Projects (Palm Hills Developments)

- [Hacienda Ras El Hekma](https://palmhillsdev.com/en/hacienda-ras-el-hekma): Ras El Hekma — North Coast. From EGP 12,032,000, 5% down payment, up to 10 years installments, delivery 2030.
- [Badya Palm Hills](https://palmhillsdev.com/en/badya): 6th of October — West Cairo. From EGP 6,892,600, 1.5% down payment, up to 12 years installments, delivery 2028 – 2031.
- [97 Hills](https://palmhillsdev.com/en/97-hills): East Cairo. From EGP 28,684,000, 2.8% down payment, up to 10 years installments, delivery 2030.

## Hacienda Ras El Hekma

Page: https://palmhillsdev.com/en/hacienda-ras-el-hekma (Arabic: https://palmhillsdev.com/hacienda-ras-el-hekma)

Hacienda Ras El Hekma is Palm Hills Developments' newest North Coast destination, covering around 1,400 feddans in Ras El Hekma with a 4.8 km sandy beachfront. The master plan is by OBMI and is laid out around lagoons and green spaces, with beach homes, chalets, twin houses and villas set in rows stepping back from the sea. All units are delivered fully finished with air conditioning and kitchens, with delivery expected in 2030.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| Beach Home 1 Bedroom | 65 m² | 12,032,000 |
| Beach Home 2 Bedrooms | 105 – 107 m² | 15,278,000 |
| Beach Home 3 Bedrooms | 143 m² | 18,131,000 |
| Seabreeze Junior Chalet | 141 m² | 23,581,000 |
| Seabreeze Senior Chalet | 167 m² | 27,171,000 |
| Seabreeze Grand Chalet | 202 – 215 m² | 33,078,000 |
| Duo Twin | Built-up area 253 m², land area 320 m² | 47,933,000 |
| Crest Villa | Built-up area 312 m², land area 419 m² | 82,188,000 |
| Coastal Villa | Built-up area 519 m², land area 800 m² | 130,058,000 |
| Bayline Villa | Built-up area 344 m², land area 841 m² | 170,389,000 |
| Beachfront Villa | Built-up area 344 m², land area 942 m² | 202,498,000 |

**Where is Hacienda Ras El Hekma located?** Hacienda Ras El Hekma is in Ras El Hekma on the International Coastal Road of Egypt's North Coast, one of the calmest and clearest bays on the Mediterranean. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Hacienda Ras El Hekma?** Prices start from EGP 12,032,000. Available units: Beach Home 1 Bedroom from EGP 12,032,000; Beach Home 2 Bedrooms from EGP 15,278,000; Beach Home 3 Bedrooms from EGP 18,131,000; Seabreeze Junior Chalet from EGP 23,581,000; Seabreeze Senior Chalet from EGP 27,171,000; Seabreeze Grand Chalet from EGP 33,078,000; Duo Twin from EGP 47,933,000; Crest Villa from EGP 82,188,000; Coastal Villa from EGP 130,058,000; Bayline Villa from EGP 170,389,000; Beachfront Villa from EGP 202,498,000.

**What payment plans are available in Hacienda Ras El Hekma?** Payment plan: 5% down payment, 5% after 3 months; installments over 10 years at the original price, or 8 years with 10% off, or 6 years with 20% off.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Hacienda Ras El Hekma?** Beach Home 1 Bedroom (65 m²); Beach Home 2 Bedrooms (105 – 107 m²); Beach Home 3 Bedrooms (143 m²); Seabreeze Junior Chalet (141 m²); Seabreeze Senior Chalet (167 m²); Seabreeze Grand Chalet (202 – 215 m²); Duo Twin (Built-up area 253 m², land area 320 m²); Crest Villa (Built-up area 312 m², land area 419 m²); Coastal Villa (Built-up area 519 m², land area 800 m²); Bayline Villa (Built-up area 344 m², land area 841 m²); Beachfront Villa (Built-up area 344 m², land area 942 m²).

**When is Hacienda Ras El Hekma delivered?** Delivery is expected in 2030, according to the developer.

**Are Hacienda Ras El Hekma homes finished?** Yes, all the units shown are delivered fully finished.

**Is palmhillsdev.com the official Hacienda Ras El Hekma website?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. palmhillsdev.com is a marketing platform owned by Ibrahim El Garhy, Sales Deputy Manager at Palm Hills. Contracts are signed directly with the company.

**Are the prices shown final?** Prices are indicative and may be changed by the developer without notice. The developer is the final reference at the time of contracting.

## Badya Palm Hills

Page: https://palmhillsdev.com/en/badya (Arabic: https://palmhillsdev.com/badya)

Badya is an integrated city by Palm Hills Developments in 6th of October on Al Wahat Road, divided into 6 districts, each with its own plan and services, connected through a central hub called The Core. The city is built around a smart, green concept, with Badya International University, schools, sports clubs and walking and cycling trails. Units available now are in Districts 2 and 6: fully finished one- to three-bedroom apartments, plus core & shell town houses and villas.

| Unit | Size | Price from (EGP) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Bedroom Apartment | 58 – 70 m² | 6,892,600 |
| 2 Bedroom Apartment | 93 – 135 m² | 9,227,300 |
| 3 Bedroom Apartment | 125 – 168 m² | 11,169,500 |
| Town House Middle | Built-up area 190.5 m², land area 189.5 m² | 21,625,000 |
| Town House Corner | Built-up area 194 m², land area 230 m² | 24,063,000 |
| Villa N2 | Built-up area 180 m², land area 255 m² | 25,318,000 |
| Villa Z2 | Built-up area 275.5 m², land area 401 m² | 33,486,000 |
| Villa X2 | Built-up area 364 m², land area 550 m² | 42,424,000 |
| Villa W2 | Built-up area 466 m², land area 750 m² | 56,767,000 |

**Where is Badya Palm Hills located?** Badya is in 6th of October, Giza, on Al Wahat Road, close to the 26th of July Corridor and Zewail Road, and to West Cairo's main landmarks. It is developed by Palm Hills Developments.

**What are the starting prices in Badya Palm Hills?** Prices start from EGP 6,892,600. Available units: 1 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 6,892,600; 2 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 9,227,300; 3 Bedroom Apartment from EGP 11,169,500; Town House Middle from EGP 21,625,000; Town House Corner from EGP 24,063,000; Villa N2 from EGP 25,318,000; Villa Z2 from EGP 33,486,000; Villa X2 from EGP 42,424,000; Villa W2 from EGP 56,767,000.

**What payment plans are available in Badya Palm Hills?** Option 1: 1.5% down payment, 1.5% after 1 month; installments over 12 years at the original price, or 10 years with 12% off, or 8 years with 22% off, or 6 years with 39% off. Option 2: 1.5% down payment, 1.5% after 1 month, 1.5% after 2 months, 1.5% after 3 months; installments over 12 years with 4% off, or 10 years with 14% off, or 8 years with 25% off, or 6 years with 43% off.

**What unit types and sizes are available in Badya Palm Hills?** 1 Bedroom Apartment (58 – 70 m²); 2 Bedroom Apartment (93 – 135 m²); 3 Bedroom Apartment (125 – 168 m²); Town House Middle (Built-up area 190.5 m², land area 189.5 m²); Town House Corner (Built-up area 194 m², land area 230 m²); Villa N2 (Built-up area 180 m², land area 255 m²); Villa Z2 (Built-up area 275.5 m², land area 401 m²); Villa X2 (Built-up area 364 m², land area 550 m²); Villa W2 (Built-up area 466 m², land area 750 m²).

**When is Badya Palm Hills delivered?** Delivery is expected in 2028 – 2031, according to the developer.

**Is palmhillsdev.com the official Badya Palm Hills website?** No. The developer is Palm Hills Developments. palmhillsdev.com is a marketing platform owned by Ibrahim El Garhy, Sales Deputy Manager at Palm Hills. Contracts are signed directly with the company.

## 97 Hills

Page: https://palmhillsdev.com/en/97-hills (Arabic: https://palmhillsdev.com/97-hills)

97 Hills is a residential project by Palm Hills Developments in East Cairo, with family homes with a garden or penthouse, town houses, and standalone villas in several sizes. Family homes and town houses are delivered fully finished and villas core & shell, with delivery expected in 2030. The project includes a clubhouse, a pool, green spaces, walking and cycling trails and a commercial promenade.
